entry.title: Corvid launches the RV-90 graphics card
entry.content:
Corvid has launched the RV-90, its new flagship graphics card. The card will cost $899. It goes on sale December 10.

Under the hood is Nocturne, the company's new graphics architecture. The card carries 24 GB of GDDR7 memory. Corvid claims the RV-90 doubles the RV-80's ray-tracing performance.
